verdict.line: You hold the lane-phase and solo-kill edge, but the 44% win rate over 50 games says it doesn't always convert — you lose when you stand still and eat Snip Snip! from range, and you win when you force the fight while her Hallowed Mist is down.

brief.thesis: Gwen's entire kit is short-ranged — Q (450) and E (400) — and her only escape is a short dash on a 13-11s cooldown, while Kled's Q hook (800 range) and E Jousting (550 range, double dash) both outreach everything she has outside her R. The lane-stat advantage sits with Kled, but Gwen's passive (A Thousand Cuts) scales bonus magic damage off the target's current health, which makes a full-health mounted Skaarl a juicy target if you let her poke freely instead of closing or resetting.

theirWindow.when: she's poking from max Q range
theirWindow.what: She's landing repeated Snip Snip! snips on Skaarl while staying at 450 range and never entering your Q's 800 range. Don't tank it passively — her passive scales off Skaarl's current health, so either close the gap with E or back out of her cone entirely.

yourWindow.when: her W (Hallowed Mist) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without the mist up (22/21/20/19/18s CD) she has no damage-mitigation bubble or targeting restriction. Q hook her at 800 range, chain into E (Jousting) and let W (Violent Tendencies) ramp your attack speed through the all-in.

start.why: The 85.5%-pick, 46.8%-WR start — sustain through her early Q trades and enough damage to punish her short dash range.

boots.why: Measured higher at 57.1% WR than Mercury's Treads, and Gwen's damage comes mostly through autos empowered by A Thousand Cuts — Steelcaps directly cuts that.

core.why: Stacks max HP into free wave and trade damage, and that HP pool is exactly what Skaarl needs to soak Gwen's poke without dismounting early.
Armor shred stacks off your E double-dash hits, turning drawn-out skirmishes into favorable damage races.
Once you're ahead from winning lane, this converts that advantage into tower pressure and forces Gwen to either match your siege or lose structures.
Sustain through omnivamp in extended mid-game duels once Gwen's passive starts punishing your health total.

situational.when: she keeps healing off A Thousand Cuts procs and you need to cut that sustain
you need single-target execute damage to close out duels faster
the enemy team's magic damage or CC outside of Gwen becomes the bigger threat

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained, repeated trading Kled's E double-dash and W attack-speed window create, and the adaptive heal keeps you ahead in extended all-ins against her sustain.

summoners.why: The clear majority pick (81.5%). Ignite punishes any all-in you commit to once her W is down and denies her ducking into Hallowed Mist to stabilize; Flash covers your E's limited 550 range when she tries to disengage.

playing.title: Hook before she sets range
playing.detail: Throw Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range) the moment she tries to settle into her 450-range Snip Snip! distance — the yank closes the gap before she gets a free snip sequence off.

playing.title: Engage outside her Q window
playing.detail: Open trades with E (Jousting, 550 range) from just outside her Q's 450 range so the dash-in itself can't be punished by her cone.

playing.title: All-in when her mist is down
playing.detail: Track Hallowed Mist's cooldown (22/21/20/19/18s). Without it she has no way to restrict who can target her — this is your commit window for Q into W (Violent Tendencies).

playing.title: Watch Skaarl's bar, not your own
playing.detail: Her passive scales bonus magic damage off the target's current health, so a healthy mounted Skaarl is a bigger target for her poke, not a safer one. Reset between exchanges instead of soaking snips.

playing.title: Double-dash through, don't dash past
playing.detail: Recast E immediately after the first hit to dash back through Gwen for the second instance of damage, rather than running past her into her W mist radius.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown whiff
playing.detail: If her Skip 'n Slash (400 range, 13-11s CD) misses, the cooldown isn't refunded — she has no gap-closer or escape up, so commit the Q hook immediately.

playing.title: Close the game before level 11-13
playing.detail: If she's free-farmed unanswered, her passive's bonus damage scales with your health total and starts outpacing your dueling. Convert any lead into towers via Hullbreaker rather than extending the lane.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, boots, and rune pages above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; several exact item-order samples are as small as 2-3 games, so treat sequencing as directional rather than exact. The ability mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reading are my own analysis, not sourced from the win-rate data.
